name: Galvesaurus
sum: Galvesaurus is a brachiosaurid sauropod from the Late Jurassic of Galve, Teruel, Spain, possibly a junior synonym of Lusotitan.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; found in the Villar del Arzobispo Formation at Cuesta Lonsal.
